integrity: The quantitative formula is derived directly from the canonical free-space distance, and the nonembedding conclusion uses published Schur and isometric-linearization theorems. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to separable real Banach spaces failing the Schur property and gauges omega_alpha(t)=max(t,t^alpha) with 0<alpha<1; no converse or endpoint statement is claimed.
title: Power-snowflake exact \(\varepsilon\)-isometries for every separable non-Schur Banach space
